pull_requests.title: Add idempotency keys to POST /charges
pull_requests.author: rkapoor
pull_requests.head: feat/idempotency-keys
pull_requests.description: Clients retry /charges on timeout and we double-charge. Store an idempotency key per charge and return the original response on replay. Closes DEL-1123.

changed_files.patch:
@@ -31,10 +31,52 @@ async def create_charge(payload: ChargeIn, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session)):
-    charge = await charges.create(session, payload)
-    return ChargeOut.from_orm(charge)
+    key = payload.idempotency_key
+    existing = await idempotency.get(session, key)
+    if existing is not None:
+        return ChargeOut.model_validate_json(existing.response_body)
+
+    charge = await charges.create(session, payload)
+    response = ChargeOut.from_orm(charge)
+    await idempotency.put(session, key, response.model_dump_json())
+    await session.commit()
+    return response

@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+async def get(session: AsyncSession, key: str) -> IdempotencyRecord | None:
+    stmt = select(IdempotencyRecord).where(IdempotencyRecord.key == key)
+    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
+
+
+async def put(session: AsyncSession, key: str, response_body: str) -> None:
+    session.add(IdempotencyRecord(key=key, response_body=response_body))
+    # NOTE: no unique constraint handling; concurrent inserts raise IntegrityError
+
+
+async def purge_expired(session: AsyncSession, older_than_hours: int = 24) -> int:
+    cutoff = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(hours=older_than_hours)
+    stmt = delete(IdempotencyRecord).where(IdempotencyRecord.created_at < cutoff)
+    result = await session.execute(stmt)
+    return result.rowcount

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+class IdempotencyRecord(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "idempotency_records"
+
+    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
+    key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), index=True)
+    response_body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text())
+    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(default=datetime.utcnow)

@@ -8,6 +8,10 @@ class ChargeIn(BaseModel):
     amount_minor: int
     currency: str
+    idempotency_key: str | None = None

pull_requests.title: Widen FX amount precision to 8 decimal places
pull_requests.author: achen
pull_requests.head: fix/fx-precision
pull_requests.description: Crypto-settled payouts were rounding to 2dp and losing fractions of a cent. Migrate numeric(18,2) to numeric(26,8).

changed_files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    op.alter_column(
+        "ledger_entries",
+        "amount",
+        type_=sa.Numeric(26, 8),
+        existing_type=sa.Numeric(18, 2),
+    )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    op.alter_column(
+        "ledger_entries",
+        "amount",
+        type_=sa.Numeric(18, 2),
+        existing_type=sa.Numeric(26, 8),
+    )

@@ -12,19 +12,31 @@ class Money:
-    def __init__(self, amount: float, currency: str) -> None:
-        self.amount = round(amount, 2)
+    def __init__(self, amount: Decimal | float | str, currency: str) -> None:
+        self.amount = Decimal(str(amount)).quantize(Decimal("0.00000001"))
         self.currency = currency
+
+    def __add__(self, other: "Money") -> "Money":
+        if other.currency != self.currency:
+            raise ValueError("cannot add different currencies")
+        return Money(self.amount + other.amount, self.currency)

pull_requests.title: Retry webhook delivery with exponential backoff
pull_requests.author: lsorensen
pull_requests.head: feat/webhook-retries
pull_requests.description: Merchant webhooks fail silently on a 503. Add 5 retries with jittered backoff and a dead-letter queue.

changed_files.patch:
@@ -44,28 +44,97 @@ async def deliver(event: WebhookEvent) -> DeliveryResult:
-    response = await client.post(event.url, json=event.payload)
-    return DeliveryResult(ok=response.status_code < 400)
+    for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
+        try:
+            response = await client.post(event.url, json=event.payload, timeout=10)
+            if response.status_code < 400:
+                return DeliveryResult(ok=True, attempts=attempt)
+        except httpx.TransportError:
+            pass
+        await asyncio.sleep(2 ** attempt)
+    await dead_letter.push(event)
+    return DeliveryResult(ok=False, attempts=MAX_ATTEMPTS)
